title: Thais, Thank You!
text: An excellent day trip out to Montserrat thanks to Thais. I learned so much about the region and wine through this experience and I hope others have the good fortune of having her as their guide if they book this tour.

title: Montserrat Half Day Tour
text:
Our tour guide, Daria, was knowledgeable, humorous and engaging. She made the tour enjoyable while sharing fascinating insights into the geological formation of Montserrat. Montserrat is truly a beautiful place worth a visit to!

The tour also included a visit to the Holy Virgin Mary in the Basilica, where we had the opportunity to touch her hand and make a wish. Despite this being only Daria’s second time guiding this tour, she did an amazing job!

title: A must experience
text: A fantastic tour. Our guides were knowledgeable, informative, helpful, entertaining and patient. The free time seemed to be a little too long, however each tourist can decide what is too long or too little. Our guide Kyra did a great job, however she could have used some help with the tapis and wine lunch. I feel she was over extended in serving and orientation of the wines and vineyard. All in all a great tour.
